description: This Java abstract class defines a strategy for handling policy events, providing a template for subclasses to implement specific event application logic. It manages null checks, revision setting, and timestamp handling for policies.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyEventStrategy
classes.description: An abstract class implementing EventStrategy for handling PolicyEvent types, providing a common framework for policy event processing with methods to apply events to policies.

methods.name: AbstractPolicyEventStrategy
methods.description: Constructor for the abstract policy event strategy class.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles a policy event, updating the policy with revision and timestamp if not null, and applying event-specific logic.

methods.name: applyEvent (with Policy parameter)
methods.description: Applies a policy event to a given Policy object, returning an updated PolicyBuilder.

methods.name: applyEvent (with PolicyBuilder parameter)
methods.description: Applies a policy event to a PolicyBuilder, default implementation returns the builder unchanged.
